base: Woodland mushroom clipart, flat vector illustration style with clean dark plum outlines and flat colours, true-to-life mushroom colours, limited palette: fly agaric red, golden chanterelle orange, warm brown, tan, lilac, moss green, fern green, cream, soft gold, deep plum; crisp edges, one isolated subject centred on a plain pure white background, no text, no lettering, no frame, no ground shadow, no background scenery, cozy and a little whimsical.
designs: a single fly agaric toadstool, bright red domed cap with white warty spots, white gills under the cap edge, a thick pale cream stem with a white skirt ring, a small bulbous base
a single morel mushroom, an upright honeycomb-pitted conical cap in warm tan-brown with dark pits, a short pale cream hollow stem
a cluster of three golden-orange chanterelle mushrooms, funnel-shaped wavy caps with ridged forked undersides, apricot yellow-orange, tapering stems
a single porcini mushroom, a plump smooth chestnut-brown cap, a thick cream-coloured swollen stem with a faint net pattern, a pale sponge underside at the cap edge
a shelf-like cluster of overlapping oyster mushrooms, smooth fan-shaped caps in soft grey-lilac and dove grey with cream gills underneath, joined at a short stub
a round puffball mushroom with a short stem base, creamy tan skin covered in tiny soft brown speckled warts, with one small puffball beside it
three small amethyst deceiver mushrooms of different sizes, rich lilac-purple caps and slender lilac stems, fading to paler lilac at the cap centres
a stack of overlapping turkey tail bracket fungi, thin wavy fan-shaped shelves with concentric bands of rust brown, teal blue-grey, tan and cream, cream edges
a small brown-capped mushroom with a cream stem standing between two curling green fern fronds and a tiny moss tuft at its base
two red spotted toadstools, one tall and one small, with two green oak leaves and two brown acorns tucked at their base, arranged as a compact group
a tight cluster of five honey fungus mushrooms of different sizes, honey-yellow and amber caps with tiny dark scales at their centres, slim cream stems with rings, joined at the base
a single tall parasol mushroom, a wide umbrella-shaped cap in cream with warm brown shaggy scales and a brown centre knob, a long slender stem with a double ring, a bulbous base
